implemented: Normal-pea conversion emits one pea-ignite sound event; melting emits one pea-melt event that reuses existing weighted throw recordings. Existing ignite impact recordings are unchanged.
Fire rate is chosen once in the source50–80range and ignition tick/rate are saved with each projectile. Scene recreation uses that history instead of resetting actor.since.
Legacy fire shots without ignition history derive reproducible phase from projectile age and the prior ID-based rate; exact lost ignition history cannot be recovered.
Conversion voices use existing combat volume,per-kind throttling,10voice combat cap,mute and release lifecycle. Early levels omit the new recording.

validation.scope: Native desktop decode/playback invocation,controlled render rebuild and cleanup. Acoustic output quality,physical iPhone,real-time frame pacing,thermal and total process/GPU memory are unverified.

performance.comment: Only selected fire-capable stages load this recording; the buffer is freed when it is no longer retained.
